column1: # Path / token transformations applied by publish-sanitize.sh.
# Format: <pattern>\t<replacement>\t<comment>
# Patterns are sed-style basic regex (BRE). Order matters — earlier rules win.
# Append-only: never delete a rule unless it produces a verified false positive.
# SETUP:
#   Add a row for each fleet-specific path or token you want to transform before
#   publishing. Replace the examples below with your actual fleet paths.
#   Pattern       = sed BRE (basic regex). Use literal paths, not wildcards.
#   Replacement   = text that will appear in the published output.
#                   Use <placeholder-style> names to signal "fill this in."
#   Comment       = free-text label for your own reference (not published).
# EXAMPLE ROWS (uncomment and adapt):
# ~/myfleet/shared/scripts/
# ~/myfleet/agents/
# ~/myfleet/
# /Users/myuser/
# ~/.myagent/
# myfleet-internal-hostname
# NOTE: path rules must be ordered longest-match-first. A rule for
# ~/myfleet/shared/ must appear before ~/myfleet/ or the shorter rule
# will transform the prefix before the longer one can match.
